Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo today — the team found the latency/cost breakdown really helpful. A couple quick procurement + security questions as we scope an internal path to purchase: 

- Procurement path: do you typically take POs for enterprise deals? Is there a CC/workflow you recommend for pilot purchases under $5k?

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the report + DPA. Answers inline: 

- Billing: for production we will do PO (net-30). Card only for pilots <$5k.
- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace purchases where feasible (primarily AWS), please let us know if Redwood is currently listed or if you can provide a marketplace quote; that can sometimes speed approvals on our side.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is required — thanks for the report. For DPA, we need Redwood to confirm subprocessors list and data retention defaults; our legal will redline if needed. We also asked about encryption at rest and role-based access for KV caches in the questionnaire.
- Timeline: 4–6 weeks is typical for us. We can expedite if we have the SOC 2/DPA and a clear PO template.

Attaching our PO process doc and the completed high-level security questionnaire highlights (PO_Process_Greenleaf.pdf).

If you can produce a one-page M.A.P. that lists the owners and expected dates we’ll be able to route this tomorrow.
